hitl_conditions: Not discussed as such; by design, restoration is automated via controllers, and corrective repair (assignment of a qualified maintenance person) remains only when ML misses a failure that HYSYS validation reveals.
key_finding: Proof-of-concept twin (Aspen HYSYS model of a cryogenic heat exchanger + decision-tree surrogate + VAR forecaster) predicts the next operating state and autonomously restores it to the nearest safe state; on synthetic scenarios it detects 52-57% of failures early and cuts cumulative downtime about 30% versus corrective maintenance.

quotes.text: To investigate the behavior of the CHE under potential disturbances, the DT replicates real-time monitoring and predicts disruptions before they occur.
This paper proposes a systematic and general framework for enhancing the robustness of the LNG supply chain, using the CHE as a specific case study.
The ripple effect of disruptions can significantly impact continuity and resilience by spreading disturbances throughout the system, ultimately compromising LNG supply chain resilience

This hybrid system operates in two stages: (1) the VAR model predicts future state variables, and (2) the selected ML model uses the VAR predictions to generate operational state forecasts (success or failure).
